compartment.title: Investigation of foundation docs, core engines, and assessment implementation
compartment.p1: Continued investigative reading across the codebase, extending the prior exploration of assessment implementation. Performed a series of greps and reads across `docs/foundations/` (theory substrate documents), `src/core/engines/` (engine implementations), `src/core/domains/`, and `src/core/assessment/` to map the current state of the theoretical model against the actual implementation. No code changes, no decisions — pure reconnaissance to understand the wiring gaps identified in the red-team audit.
compartment.p2: Extended investigation across foundation docs, core engines, and assessment files to map theoretical model against current implementation state.
compartment.p3: Broad codebase reconnaissance spanning foundation docs, engines, and assessment layer.
